title: See VoiceBridge in Action
description: A clean, accessible interface designed for children, parents, and therapy centers — simple enough for a child, powerful enough for professionals.

board.label: 🗣️ Communication Board
board.desc: Child taps a card — it speaks aloud and notifies the parent instantly.

parent-setup.label: 👶 Add Child Profile
parent-setup.desc: Set up a child profile in under a minute. Choose name, language, and a photo.

parent-dashboard.label: 🏠 Parent Dashboard
parent-dashboard.desc: See all profiles, live alerts, and recent communication events in one place.

card-config.label: 💳 Configure Cards
card-config.desc: Toggle, reorder, and customise communication cards with a simple drag-and-drop interface.

therapy.label: 🏥 Therapy Center
therapy.desc: Manage families, assign therapists, and monitor progress across the entire center.

alerts.label: 🔔 Alerts
alerts.desc: Parents receive instant push notifications and can acknowledge requests in one tap.
